mostWorthwhile.text: Fitting the spring and testing the lifter was most worthwhile: the comparison showed how the parts work together to turn rotation into reliable up-and-down motion.

leastWorthwhile.text: My first attempt to join the cam directly to the shaft was least worthwhile, though it prompted me to build the support first.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the light follower sometimes hung without the spring pulling it against the cam.
